question: Why was Acquirer B's final approval on domestic debit in Mexico lower from 6 to 14 August 2026 than in the two weeks before?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN business_date < DATE'2026-08-06' THEN '1_23jul_05aug' WHEN business_date <= DATE'2026-08-14' THEN '2_06_14aug' ELSE '3_16_29aug' END AS period, sum(payments_sent) AS payments_sent, round(sum(first_attempt_approved) / sum(payments_sent), 4) AS first_attempt_approval_rate, round(sum(final_approved) / sum(payments_sent), 4) AS final_approval_rate, round(sum(recovered_by_cascade) / sum(payments_sent), 4) AS recovered_share FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_approval_daily WHERE country = 'MX' AND acquirer_id = 'B' AND card_type = 'debit' AND NOT is_cross_border AND business_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-07-23' AND DATE'2026-08-29' AND business_date <> DATE'2026-08-15' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_cascade_health('MX', '2026-08-06 07:00:00', '2026-08-15 07:00:00', 'debit') WHERE acquirer_id = 'B' ORDER BY window_failures DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT change_id, changed_at_mexico_city, change_type, scope, description FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_change_log WHERE change_id IN ('CHG-0806', 'CHG-0815')

facts.K1: The loss came from retries, not from first attempts: B's first-attempt approval on Mexican domestic debit stayed about flat (about 76%), while the share of payments recovered by cascading fell (about 5.6% of payments before, 2.8% on 6-14 August).
facts.K2: Cause: decline-code mapping v2.3 for Acquirer B (CHG-0806, 6 August) made 'do not honor' (05) declines hard / non-retryable, so they were no longer retried on another acquirer; the mapping hotfix v2.3.1 (CHG-0815, 15 August) restored the retries.
facts.K3: Size: final approval about 79.1% on 6-14 August against about 81.8% in the two weeks before (about -2.7 pp), back to about 81.7% after 15 August.
facts.K4: No daily anomaly was flagged for Mexico; the retry alert (gold_cascade_alerts_daily) flagged B / 05 from 6 August.

question: Were cross-border debit payments in Colombia affected by the incident of 13-14 August 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT is_cross_border, first_acquirer_id, CASE WHEN created_ts_local >= TIMESTAMP'2026-08-13 14:00:00' THEN 'window' ELSE 'baseline_14_days' END AS period, count(*) AS payments_sent, round(avg(CAST(final_approved AS INT)), 4) AS final_approval_rate FROM workspace.approval_copilot.silver_payments WHERE country = 'CO' AND card_type = 'debit' AND sent_to_acquirer AND created_ts_local >= TIMESTAMP'2026-07-30 14:00:00' AND created_ts_local < TIMESTAMP'2026-08-14 12:10:00' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 3, 2

SELECT is_cross_border, business_date, sum(payments_sent) AS payments_sent, round(sum(final_approved) / sum(payments_sent), 4) AS final_approval_rate FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_approval_daily WHERE country = 'CO' AND card_type = 'debit' AND business_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-08-11' AND DATE'2026-08-15' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT change_id, changed_at_bogota, description FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_change_log WHERE change_id IN ('CHG-0813', 'CHG-0814')

facts.K1: No: the final approval of cross-border debit in Colombia did not fall (about 71.7% in the 14 days before, about 71.9% in the incident window). It carries only 60-80 payments a day, so its daily rate swings between about 68% and 82% around those days without any incident.
facts.K2: Because routing v14 (CHG-0813) moved only domestic debit to Acquirer B; cross-border debit stayed on Acquirer A.

question: Did the two merchants onboarded in Mexico on 20 August 2026 change the approval rate there?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN merchant_id IN ('MX-M13', 'MX-M14') THEN 'new merchants' ELSE 'existing merchants' END AS merchants, count(*) AS payments_sent, round(avg(CAST(final_approved AS INT)), 4) AS final_approval_rate FROM workspace.approval_copilot.silver_payments WHERE country = 'MX' AND sent_to_acquirer AND NOT is_cross_border AND created_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP'2026-08-20 14:00:00' GROUP BY 1

SELECT merchant_id, merchant_segment, count(*) AS payments_sent, round(avg(CAST(final_approved AS INT)), 4) AS final_approval_rate FROM workspace.approval_copilot.silver_payments WHERE country = 'MX' AND sent_to_acquirer AND NOT is_cross_border AND merchant_id IN ('MX-M13', 'MX-M14') GROUP BY 1, 2
SELECT count(*) AS flagged_days FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_anomalies_daily WHERE country = 'MX' AND is_anomaly
SELECT change_id, changed_at_mexico_city, description FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_change_log WHERE change_id = 'CHG-0820'

facts.K1: No material change: the new merchants (MX-M13 retail, MX-M14 food delivery; CHG-0820) were about 9% of Mexican domestic payments sent after 20 August, and their final approval (about 87.0%) was in line with that of the existing merchants (about 86.7%), so they barely moved the country rate.
facts.K2: No anomaly was flagged in Mexico, before or after 20 August.

question: Did the 3DS SDK upgrade on web checkout on 28 July 2026 change approval or 3DS outcomes in Mexico or Colombia?
gold_sql: SELECT country, CASE WHEN created_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP'2026-07-28 16:00:00' THEN 'week before' ELSE 'week after' END AS period, count(*) AS payments_sent, round(avg(CAST(final_approved AS INT)), 4) AS final_approval_rate, round(avg(CAST(three_ds_requested AS INT)), 4) AS three_ds_requested_share FROM workspace.approval_copilot.silver_payments WHERE country IN ('MX', 'CO') AND channel = 'web' AND sent_to_acquirer AND NOT is_cross_border AND created_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP'2026-07-21 16:00:00' AND created_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP'2026-08-04 16:00:00' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT country, CASE WHEN business_date < DATE'2026-07-28' THEN 'week before' ELSE 'week after' END AS period, sum(payment_intents) AS payment_intents, round(sum(abandoned_3ds) / sum(payment_intents), 4) AS abandoned_3ds_share FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_funnel_daily WHERE country IN ('MX', 'CO') AND business_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-07-21' AND DATE'2026-08-04' AND business_date <> DATE'2026-07-28' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT count(*) AS flagged_days FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_anomalies_daily WHERE country IN ('MX', 'CO') AND is_anomaly AND business_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-07-21' AND DATE'2026-08-04'

facts.K1: No measurable change in approval: final approval in Mexico and Colombia moved by less than about 0.6 pp between the week before and the week after (web checkout: about 86.5% to 86.8% in Mexico, about 86.8% to 86.9% in Colombia), and no anomaly was flagged.
facts.K2: No change in 3DS outcomes either: the share of intents abandoned in the 3DS challenge stayed at about 0.8-1.0%, and the share of payments that asked for 3DS did not change (about 29% in Mexico and 24-25% in Colombia on web).
